bio: Came up with Logopandecteision, a universal language.
name: Thomas Urquhart

pieces.content:
New solutions tend to find old problems.
They don't solve but reagent. Children
are choiceless, while anything goes to sugar
in breaking down. Earthed-heart:
This book too is for nobody and
pregnant and ingenious Spirits.

You speak a language of going to sugar.
In other words you amaylase. And i want
to soften paper and digest a school;
preserved by Bayes from the mischief
of lightning and thunder
pieces.readme: In incredulity towards the idea of the Internet as the protocol in advance of an universal language. And that an elephant has no joints. And a horse has no gall. And a pigeon has no gall.
pieces.title: Affinity electing
